reason: Notify Frank Castle's patient-facing app of status changes on his surgical extraction referral (Task/task-referral-pa-tracking), so the app can surface milestone updates (PA approved, referral sent, appointment confirmed) without Frank needing to call either office.

note.text: Per the HL7 FHIR Subscriptions R4 Backport IG, same pattern established for UC01: the SubscriptionTopic canonical URL is carried directly in Subscription.criteria, not via a separate extension. This single Subscription spans both I1 (PA approval notification) and I2 (referral sent, appointment confirmed notifications) — same referral Task tracked throughout.
